class.name: OcgBrepprimapiMakewedge
class.brief_description: Describes functions to build wedges, i.e. boxes with inclined faces. A MakeWedge object provides a framework for: - defining the construction of a wedge, - implementing the construction algorithm, and - consulting the result.
class.description: ! Describes functions to build wedges, i.e. boxes with inclined faces. ! A MakeWedge object provides a framework for: ! - defining the construction of a wedge, ! - implementing the construction algorithm, and ! - consulting the result.
